title: Airports?
content: I’m a bit confused about whether this even qualifies as a mall world dream. But if I search dream subs in Reddit about airports, the posts seems to link to this sub or mention mall world. It’s unusual for me to have recurring dreams that happen in the same location. Recurring themes, yes. Specifics of the locations (other than generic “airport”) are rare. But I do have recurring dreams about airports. I’m late for a flight, went to the wrong gate, screwed something up and ended up having to go somewhere else in the airport. I did dream we were on a plane that had an unsuccessful takeoff and we knew it would crash but the dream didn’t end with a crash, it just ended. Recently, I had a dream that I got to the airport just fine for my flight but that I forgot that I’d intended to change my itinerary to go visit some other people first. The airports (and occasionally the planes themselves) are always grander and more elaborate than in real life. But most of the time I’m not spending a lot of time exploring them. The focus is almost always on something going wrong with actually getting to the flight. There have been a few labyrinthine, mall-like airports. Is this a mall world dream? Or should I post on a different sub. Airports are the only recurring-location dream I have.
